data.rationale: Added 'decision trace <id>' command to show full decision context: what it affects (JUSTIFIES, MOTIVATES), what it supersedes (SUPERSEDES), and what supersedes it (SUPERSEDED_BY). This fills the gap identified during sub-agent testing - the protocol referenced 'decision why' for viewing decisions, but that command traces why a TASK exists. Now 'decision trace' provides the full graph context around a decision.
data.title: Add decision trace command
